note: KYA-OS story F-1 credential split. Regenerate with pnpm generate:credential-fixtures whenever src/core/credentials/ changes. Keys are TEST-ONLY. Do not hand-edit.

chains.name: three_hop_valid
chains.description: user → parent → child → grandchild, every hop narrows its parent

chains.name: single_root
chains.description: the root alone grants the parent its full authority

chains.name: resource_owner_asserted
chains.description: the verifier pins the user as the resource owner and the chain roots there

chains.name: resource_owner_mismatch
chains.description: the verifier pins another resource owner

chains.name: broadened_action
chains.description: the leaf adds write:orders, which its parent never delegated

chains.name: dropped_caveat
chains.description: the leaf drops the MaxAmount caveat

chains.name: widened_max_amount
chains.description: the leaf raises MaxAmount above its parent

chains.name: changed_currency
chains.description: the leaf switches the MaxAmount currency

chains.name: changed_unknown_caveat
chains.description: the leaf alters a caveat type it does not understand instead of replicating it

chains.name: extended_valid_until
chains.description: the leaf expires after its parent

chains.name: extended_valid_until_caveat
chains.description: the leaf ValidUntil caveat is later than its parent caveat

chains.name: broken_parent_capability
chains.description: the leaf names a parent capability that is not its parent

chains.name: broken_continuity
chains.description: the leaf is issued by the parent agent, not by the delegate the previous hop named

chains.name: target_drift
chains.description: the leaf names another resource

chains.name: wrong_resource
chains.description: the chain is evaluated at a resource other than its invocationTarget

chains.name: root_parent_mismatch
chains.description: the root's parentCapability is not its invocationTarget

chains.name: expired_leaf
chains.description: evaluated after the leaf validUntil

chains.name: not_yet_valid
chains.description: evaluated before validFrom

chains.name: within_clock_skew
chains.description: evaluated 60 seconds after the leaf validUntil, inside the 120 second tolerance

chains.name: too_long
chains.description: eleven hops are refused for their length before any is read

chains.name: length_limit_lowered
chains.description: a verifier may cap the chain lower than 10

chains.name: empty
chains.description: no hops at all

chains.name: extra_subject_member
chains.description: the leaf credentialSubject carries a member the profile does not name (Core L3.5a)

chains.name: unsigned_leaf
chains.description: the leaf has no proof

chains.name: tampered_proof
chains.description: the leaf proofValue is altered: local rules hold, the proof does not
